summary: Americas Gold & Silver Corporation filed a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, furnishing a news release announcing publication of its inaugural Corporate Sustainability Report for 2025, covering all operating sites. The report discloses a company-wide ESG materiality assessment identifying 17 factors, a 2025 Scope 1 and 2 GHG baseline, and new policies on health and safety, environment, and supplier conduct. No transaction, shareholder vote, or capital event is involved. The filing is a routine disclosure by a foreign private issuer; no deal terms, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock apply, with no risk-arb angle.
